Container.Name: skiptro
Container.Overview: Automatic TV show intro and credits detection using audio fingerprinting. Scans your media library and generates skip markers that Kodi (via service.skiptro) can use to auto-skip intros during playback. Manage it from the built-in web UI.
Container.Changes:
[center][b]Skiptro Change Log[/b][/center]
[b]v1.3.1[/b]
[u]CLI[/u] - **`show window` takes minutes**: it asked for seconds while the web UI offered minutes, so the same setting wanted a different unit depending on where you set it. `skiptro show window "/path/to/Show" 30` now means 30 minutes.
[b]v1.3.0[/b] Late intros are detected instead of discarded, new episodes in a scanned season are picked up on their own, and shows with a long cold open can widen how far detection looks.
[u]Detection[/u] - **Late intros are kept**: an episode whose intro starts much later than the rest of its season is no longer discarded. Reported by bobrap. - **Recovery searches the whole window**: the last-resort match for a missed episode only looked where the other intros sat, so it could never find a late one. - **Search window per show**: widen detection to 20, 30, 45 or 60 minutes on the show's page, or with `skiptro show window `. For shows whose cold open pushes the title sequence past the first 15 minutes. Reported by Andy2244 (skiptro-releases#6).
[u]Scanning[/u] - **New episodes in a scanned season**: a failed incremental scan no longer marks the season complete, so a later addition is picked up by the next scan. Reported by WegoW (skiptro-releases#7). - **Show and season scans report their tally**: they always summarised zero intros found. - **Scan progress reaches the log**: season progress and skips reach scan.log, not just the Activity page.
[u]Desktop[/u] - **Uninstall cleans up**: removing Skiptro clears its "Start with Windows" entry and shortcuts. - **Start with Windows shows the real state**: the tray checkmark re-reads the registry, so an entry disabled in Task Manager no longer shows as on.
[b]v1.2.0[/b] Intro signatures keep skipping intros on shows you watch and delete, even when a season is down to a single episode, plus a few Shows page refinements.
[u]Intro signatures[/u] - **Match a lone episode**: detection normally needs at least two episodes in a season to compare against each other. With intro signatures on, Skiptro stores a small audio fingerprint of each show's intro, so a new or leftover episode still gets its intro matched after the earlier ones are gone. Off by default; turn it on under Settings or with `skiptro fingerprints enable`. - **No re-scan to start**: for a library you have already scanned, the Generate action on the Stats page (or `skiptro fingerprints generate`) builds signatures from your existing detections, no re-scanning. - **Manage per show or in bulk**: the Stats page shows which shows have a signature and lets you generate, clear, or prune them, per show or all at once. `skiptro fingerprints` does the same from the command line (list, clear, prune).
[u]Web UI[/u] - **Shows list keeps its place**: opening a show and going back keeps your sort order and scroll position instead of jumping to the top. - **Filter chips**: active filters on the Shows page show as chips, with quick "needs scanning" and "no intro" filters and a Clear filters link. - **Library rename in a dialog**: renaming a library opens a small dialog instead of editing inline.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Skiptro web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data: scan results, library config, and database.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Path to your TV show library. Must be read-write so skiptro can write .skiptro.json files alongside episodes. Add more paths below if your media is spread across multiple shares.

Config.Name: Media Paths
Config.Description: Container paths to register as media libraries (comma-separated). Must match your volume mount targets above. If you add more path mappings, add the container paths here too.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank and the web UI is open to anyone on your network. Set a long random value to require it for access from other devices. For access from outside your LAN, use a VPN or an authenticated reverse proxy.
